reports.title: Voyager Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Revenue, Bookings and Backlog

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Voyager is raising the lower end of its full-year 2026 revenue guidance by $10 million to a revised range of $285 million–$305 million, representing expected year-over-year growth of approximately 72%–84%. The increased outlook reflects strong third-quarter performance, continued bookings momentum and growing visibility from the Company's record backlog, reinforcing management's confidence in its growth trajectory.

The foregoing estimates are forward-looking and reflect management’s view of current and future market conditions, subject to certain risks and uncertainties, including certain assumptions with respect to our ability to efficiently and on a timely basis integrate acquisitions, obtain and retain contracts, changes in the timing and/or amount of government spending, react to changes in the demand for our products, activities of
